agencies_overrides_non_negative.name: agencies_overrides_non_negative
agencies_overrides_non_negative.value:
coalesce("agencies"."first_request_due_days", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("agencies"."upcoming_days", 0) >= 0
        AND coalesce("agencies"."follow_up_days", 1) >= 1 AND coalesce("agencies"."statement_request_days", 0) >= 0
        AND coalesce("agencies"."statement_follow_up_days", 1) >= 1

bills_of_lading_payment_active.name: bills_of_lading_payment_active
bills_of_lading_payment_active.where: "bills_of_lading"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "bills_of_lading"."deposit_payment_id" IS NOT NULL

bills_of_lading_void.name: bills_of_lading_void
bills_of_lading_void.value:
("bills_of_lading"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "bills_of_lading"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "bills_of_lading"."void_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("bills_of_lading"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bills_of_lading"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("bills_of_lading"."void_reason")) > 0)

deposit_payments_void.name: deposit_payments_void
deposit_payments_void.value:
("deposit_payments"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "deposit_payments"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "deposit_payments"."void_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("deposit_payments"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deposit_payments"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("deposit_payments"."void_reason")) > 0)

receipt_queue_resolution.name: receipt_queue_resolution
receipt_queue_resolution.value:
("receipt_queue"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "receipt_queue"."resolution" IS NULL AND "receipt_queue"."payment_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("receipt_queue"."resolution" = 'DISCARDED' AND "receipt_queue"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "receipt_queue"."payment_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("receipt_queue"."resolution" = 'SAVED' AND "receipt_queue"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "receipt_queue"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL)

requests_sent.name: requests_sent
requests_sent.value: ("requests"."send_status" = 'SENT') = ("requests"."requested_on" IS NOT NULL AND "requests"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL)

users_username_format.name: users_username_format
users_username_format.value: "users"."username" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9._-]*' AND length("users"."username") BETWEEN 2 AND 64
